description: Import page UI improvements: drag-and-drop file upload, improved provider detection UX (badge + Change dialog), skeleton loading during parse and review, and a two-column desktop layout (≥1024px).

userStories.title: Add shadcn Skeleton component
userStories.description: As a developer, I need a Skeleton component in components/ui/ so that later stories can render animated loading placeholders.
acceptanceCriteria: src/components/ui/skeleton.tsx exists and exports a Skeleton component
Skeleton accepts a className prop and renders a div with animate-pulse and bg-muted classes
Component follows the existing shadcn component pattern (cn utility for className merging)
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Implement drag-and-drop file upload area
userStories.description: As a user, I want to drag a CSV file onto the import page so that I don't have to use the file picker every time.
acceptanceCriteria: The plain <Input type='file' /> in import-uploader.tsx is replaced by a styled drop zone div
Drop zone has a dashed border, rounded corners, an upload icon (lucide-react UploadCloud), and the text 'Drag & drop your CSV here, or click to browse'
Drag-entering the zone sets isDraggingOver state to true and applies a highlighted style (border-primary bg-primary/5)
Drag-leaving or dropping resets isDraggingOver to false
Dropping a .csv or text/csv file sets selectedFile state; dropping any other file type does nothing
Clicking anywhere inside the drop zone triggers fileInputRef.current.click() to open the native file picker
A hidden <input type='file' accept='.csv,text/csv' /> remains for the file picker and for programmatic reset after successful import
When a file is selected (by drop or browse), a row below the drop zone shows the filename and formatted file size with an X button that clears selectedFile and resets the input ref
No new npm package is added — only native onDragOver, onDragLeave, onDrop events
Drop zone has role='button' and tabIndex={0} with an onKeyDown handler that triggers click on Enter or Space
Typecheck passes
Verify in browser using dev-browser skill

userStories.title: Improve provider detection UX with badge and Change dialog
userStories.description: As a user, I want to see which provider was auto-detected and be able to change it via a clear button, so I have confidence the correct mapping is used.
acceptanceCriteria: The existing <Select> provider dropdown is removed from import-uploader.tsx
Before any parse attempt the provider section is not rendered
After a successful or failed parse attempt, a provider status row is shown beneath the drop zone
When detection.state is 'certain': a green Badge shows the provider name and a ghost Button with a pencil icon labelled 'Change' appears next to it
When detection.state is 'uncertain': a yellow/amber Badge shows the provider name (or 'Unknown' if none), a 'Change' Button appears, and a helper text reads 'Detection was uncertain — please confirm'
When detection.state is 'missing': a red Badge labelled 'No provider detected' and a Button labelled 'Select provider' appear
Clicking Change or Select provider opens a shadcn Dialog (from components/ui/dialog.tsx)
The dialog lists all providers from providerDetection.candidates (or all available providers if candidates is empty) as radio-style selectable cards showing provider name
A 'Confirm' button inside the dialog updates selectedProvider state and closes the dialog
A 'Cancel' button closes the dialog without changing state
After confirming a new provider the badge immediately reflects the chosen provider name
Typecheck passes
Verify in browser using dev-browser skill

userStories.title: Skeleton loading during CSV parsing
userStories.description: As a user, I want to see skeleton placeholders while my CSV is being parsed so the page feels responsive instead of frozen.
acceptanceCriteria: While importLoading is true, the area below the Parse CSV button shows a parse-summary skeleton: 4 skeleton rows (full-width Skeleton elements) mimicking the DL/DD summary list
While importLoading is true, a table skeleton of 5 rows with 6 skeleton cells each is also shown below the summary skeleton
The skeletons are shown only when importLoading is true and are not visible alongside real parse results
The Parse CSV button shows a Loader2 spinner icon (from lucide-react, animate-spin) and the label 'Parsing…' while importLoading is true
The Parse CSV button is disabled while importLoading is true
When importLoading becomes false the skeletons are removed and replaced by real content or an error message
Skeleton component from US-001 is used for all placeholders
Typecheck passes
Verify in browser using dev-browser skill

userStories.title: Extract review table component with skeleton fallback
userStories.description: As a user, I want row-level skeletons to appear while the review table hydrates so there are no empty-cell flashes after parsing.
acceptanceCriteria: The review table JSX is extracted from import-uploader.tsx into a new client component at src/app/import/import-review-table.tsx
ImportReviewTable receives rows, categories, categoryDecisions, messageDecisions, and their setter callbacks as props
A ReviewTableSkeleton component (co-located in import-review-table.tsx or import-uploader.tsx) renders a Table shell with the same 6 columns but Skeleton cells for 8 rows

In import-uploader.tsx, when importLoading is false and parseResult?.review?.rows exists, ImportReviewTable is rendered; otherwise ReviewTableSkeleton is shown while importLoading is true (reusing the skeleton from US-004)
The Submit reviewed rows button remains in import-uploader.tsx outside any conditional and is only rendered when parseResult?.review is defined
No behaviour change to category or message decision logic — only structural extraction
Typecheck passes
Verify in browser using dev-browser skill

userStories.title: Two-column desktop layout for import page
userStories.description: As a desktop user (≥1024px), I want the upload controls and review table to use horizontal space so I don't have to scroll past the form to see my transactions.
acceptanceCriteria: The outer wrapper in import-uploader.tsx uses flex flex-col lg:flex-row lg:items-start gap-6
The left column contains account selector, drop zone, provider detection badge/button, and Parse CSV button; it uses lg:w-96 lg:shrink-0
The left column has lg:sticky lg:top-6 lg:self-start so controls stay visible while scrolling the review table
The right column (flex-1 min-w-0) contains parse summary, validation errors, and the review table (ImportReviewTable)
The review table container has overflow-x-auto so the table can scroll horizontally if it overflows the column
On screens below lg (< 1024px) the layout is a single column stack, matching the previous behaviour
Typecheck passes
Verify in browser using dev-browser skill
